sn34.2:1.4: sāvatthī. tatra kho …pe… cattārome bhikkhave jhāyī. katame cattāro.
sn34.2:1.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo.
sn34.2:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo. idha
sn34.2:1.7: pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo.
sn34.2:1.8: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca. tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ ṭhitikusalo ca. ayaṃ
sn34.2:1.9: imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro
sn34.2:1.10: ca. seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ khīramhā dadhi dadhimhā navanītaṃ navanītamhā sappi sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tatra aggamakkhāyati evameva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ
